name: 3d-boat-physics-simulator
description: A deterministic, modular browser-based 3D marine simulator with vessel physics, navigation, collisions, damage, flooding, and missions.

scripts.test:collision-architecture: npm run test:obstacle-sync && npm run test:collision-lifecycle && npm run test:collision-runtime
scripts.test:vessel-architecture: npm run test:condition-runtime && npm run test:dynamics-runtime && npm run test:telemetry-runtime && npm run test:presentation-runtime && npm run test:render-models && npm run test:collision-architecture
scripts.test:product-suite: npm run test:product-experience && npm run test:product-gameplay && npm run test:product-settings
scripts.test:physical-calibration: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/physical-calibration-contract.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/external-reference-contract.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/reference-configuration-contract.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/reference-loading-case-contract.mjs
